IMP CM [AVR SEV] ALEXAND AVG ; FIDES MILITVM

Complete Roman silver denarius of Severus Alexander (222 - 235 AD) RIC IVii 139, c.52 (Reece 11). Obv: laureate draped bust facing right. Legend: IMP CM [AVR SEV] ALEXAND AVG. Rev: Fides standing left with a standard in each hand. Legend: FIDES MILITVM. Diameter: 19.45mm. Thickness: 1.84mm. Weight: 1.9g
